one_line: Google released Gemini 4 Neon, Meta faced privacy probes over Muse AI, and security incidents hit Microsoft and enterprise deployments.

themes.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon model
themes.text: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Neon, a midtier model for complex workflows with a 1 million-token context window, alongside the Genie 4 interactive world model featuring native audio.

stories.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon model for complex workflows
Google releases Gemini 4 Neon model for complex workflows
Google DeepMind releases Genie 4 world model with native audio

themes.title: Security incidents hit Meta and Microsoft
themes.text: Meta staff raised alarms over privacy leaks in the Muse AI agent, while hackers compromised a Microsoft Python package on PyPI to steal developer credentials. A ServiceNow survey also revealed widespread security incidents involving enterprise AI agents.

stories.headline: Meta staff raised alarms over Muse AI privacy issues and data leaks
Microsoft's Agent Framework PyPI package compromised with credential stealer

AI-assisted hackers breach Delhi-NCR NBFCs and divert Rs 65 cr

themes.title: Lawmakers launch multiple AI probes
themes.text: US lawmakers questioned Microsoft over a reported ByteDance deal, House Democrats opened a probe into Commerce Secretary Lutnick's Nvidia ties, and Arizona launched a criminal investigation into AI companies over rogue agents.

stories.headline: Alibaba used regional companies to access Nvidia chips and aid military-linked lab

themes.title: Firms restructure and scale AI investments
themes.text: Intel signed its first outside customer for 18A-P chips, Tencent reported a surge in AI capital expenditures, and Microsoft offered buyouts to 60,000 employees as part of an AI reorganization.
